blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Gilas Pilipinas suffered a setback even before the first whistle in its upcoming FIBA Basketball World Cup Asian Qualifiers campaign after high-flying forward Rhenz Abando was ruled out due to an injury. Gilas Pilipinas head coach Tim Cone announced the development on Friday, ahead of the team’s departure for Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on Saturday, November 21. Forward Troy Rosario will replace Abando in the 12-man roster. Abando sprained his right ankle while playing for his Korean Basketball League (KBL) team, Anyang Jung Kwan Jang Red Boosters, in their 86-82 victory over Busan KCC. BASKETBALL FANS: Pro or Panalay?
